title: Recommendation Serving
currentHint: Saving creates a new version; changes apply to recommendations served from then on.
minFavouriteOrdersHint: A customer needs at least this many orders of an item before it counts as a favourite.
bestSellerMaxRankHint: Items ranked at or above this position are marked as best sellers.
bestSellerMinListSizeHint: Best sellers are only marked when the list has at least this many items.
rejectionSuppressionDaysHint: How long an item a customer rejected stays out of their recommendations and often-ordered-with suggestions. Other customers are not affected. 0 turns this off.
repeatCooldownHoursHint: How long an item shown to a customer but not accepted moves down in their recommendations, so other items get a turn. Accepting it lifts this. 0 turns this off.
feedbackWindowMinutesHint: How long after items are shown accepted or rejected feedback still counts towards that recommendation; later feedback still updates the customer's preferences. A shown item only starts rotating once this has passed, so suggestions stay put during a visit.
cooldownAfterFeedbackWindow: Rotation must last longer than the feedback window, or be 0 to turn it off.

history.title: Version History
history.restoreConfirmDescription: This creates a new version with these settings and makes it the current one.
